title: Manage employee leave and return to work
summary: When a worker requests time away or returns from an absence. A confidential approved leave and return plan reconciled with payroll, coverage and local requirements.
outcomes: A confidential approved leave and return plan reconciled with payroll, coverage and local requirements.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a worker requests time away or returns from an absence.

parts.title: Record the request and working arrangements privately
parts.guidance: Collect the relevant dates, work location, schedule, contract and applicable policy without requesting unnecessary medical or family details. Keep sensitive information restricted to the people who need it.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm entitlement, pay and required process
parts.guidance: HR and local advisers check the actual leave type, eligibility, notices and employment protections. Resolve conflicts between policy and applicable rules rather than applying the source country's entitlement globally.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm entitlement, pay and required process

parts.title: Agree the leave and coverage plan
parts.guidance: The authorized manager and HR confirm dates, communications, work handover and any review points with the employee. Record adjustments and distinguish consent to share an update from access to sensitive supporting evidence.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Agree the leave and coverage plan

parts.title: Implement approved calendar and payroll changes
parts.guidance: Authorized operators update the relevant systems using the reviewed dates and pay treatment. Check access and communication expectations, retaining evidence of the approved change rather than changing employment terms informally.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Implement approved calendar and payroll changes

parts.title: Review the return and reconcile records
parts.guidance: Discuss return arrangements and needed support with the employee and HR. Reconcile payroll and leave balances, confirm role coverage and retain only the evidence required under the applicable retention process.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review the return and reconcile records

verify.how: A confidential approved leave and return plan reconciled with payroll, coverage and local requirements.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
